name: Haruhi
source:
Marin's bubbly best friend, whom she's known since childhood. Although Haruhi is biologically male, he/she always dresses in the girls' school uniform. Haruhi is two years younger than Marin.

[spoiler]Has a romantic side ending.[/spoiler]
